thread.title: Biden's Private Conversations with Biographer Released
thread.title_full: Biden's Private Conversations with Biographer Released

author: BILL BARROW - Associated Press
title: Biden's Private Conversations with Biographer Released
text: • Newly released audio tapes and 117 pages of transcripts were disclosed by the Oversight Project, an arm of the Heritage Foundation.• The tapes and transcripts contain Biden sharing classified information with his biographer, Mark Lewis Zwonitzer.• Biden appeared to admit retaining classified information from his time as vice president in a 2017 session.• The potentially classified information itself is redacted in both the audio and transcripts.• Biden cooperated with Special Counsel Robert Hur's inquiry and told him that he did not intentionally mishandle any classified material.• Hur obtained the tapes as part of his inquiry and said that a jury would find Biden a sympathetic figure due to his age and "poor memory."• Biden was 74 when the interviews began and 81 when Special Counsel Hur released his report in early 2024.• The tapes contain instances of Biden being unable to recall some dates and details of topics he was discussing with Zwonitzer.• Biden showed a command of many details, recalling meetings and details of conversations referenced in the notes he shared.• A Biden spokesman blasted the release as politically motivated.• Biden initially sued to stop the Department of Justice from releasing the material, but dropped his suit after a divided panel of appeals court judges rejected his bid.• A three-judge panel from the circuit court found a "substantial" public interest in disclosing the material.
summary: Newly released audio tapes, disclosed by a conservative activist group, appear to show Joe Biden sharing classified information with a biographer and sometimes claiming memory lapses during interviews that occurred before his election to the presidency in 2020. About three hours of audio and 117 pages of transcripts — with many redactions — were released by the Oversight Project, an arm of the Heritage Foundation, after Biden lost a prolonged legal fight to keep his conservations with his memoir ghostwriter, Mark Lewis Zwonitzer, private.
